description: This file defines a React component 'Column' for a Kanban board UI, handling display, editing, and deletion of columns along with associated cards.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title, ensuring it is not empty and differs from the current title.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing mode for the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the edited column title after validation and calls updateColumn.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events during title editing, specifically Enter to save and Escape to cancel.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers the display of the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the column and associated cleanup.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
